_instructions: Storage settings shared by the API and loop. The encryption key stays private in the state root; only this switch ships here.

admin_database_encryption._instructions: true seals the administrator account's records with the installation key (default; a missing or invalid file also keeps encryption on). false lets the fixed admin account store new records as authenticated plaintext for troubleshooting; other accounts and secrets are always sealed and existing records stay readable either way. Saved from the administrator encryption page; adopted at the next write in each process.

user_database_pools._instructions: max_connected: how many account databases may hold open connections at once in each process (API and loop; at least 8). Each connection is one thread and the containers allow 1,024 tasks. A request that finds every slot in use waits for an idle database to give way, then for connect_wait_ms, and is refused with a retryable 503 instead of opening another thread. 192 slots with 2 connections each is at most 384 account threads: measured at 400 concurrent users on the tester, 2026-11-24 (work/unified-plan/api-task-limit.md). max_connections: connections one account database may hold (1-8, default 2). idle_seconds: how long an idle account connection stays open (1-60, default 5). Read at process start.

deleted_sessions._instructions: retention_days: how long the records a permanently deleted chat leaves behind (its deletion marker, delete receipts and Main Notes) are kept before they are purged (at least 1). A deleted chat can never be opened or restored; the wait only keeps a repeated delete request answering as before. The purge runs when the same account deletes another chat. Read on each deletion.

process._instructions: max_blocking_threads: threads the runtime may add for blocking work (file calls, password hashing, database setup; 8-256, default 64, the shipped file 256). Each is one task against the container's limit; read before the runtime starts. The sidekick tester at 400 users, 2026-11-24: 64 queued sign-ins behind password hashing (401s and dropped connections); 256 keeps that path parallel and stays far below 1,024 tasks.
